answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring employer-vouched stake: a new identity may only accept paid work after three distinct verified clients each lock a small refundable deposit behind it, released after honest completion. A violet-flagged identity that cheats loses all three deposits at once, while a walnut-shell operation spawning hundreds of clones must find hundreds of distinct real clients willing to risk money on each, so cost scales linearly with every fake. The pulse of the system is this escrow check at every job: no vouch, no paid work, so cloning yields no income.
